last_result.verdict: FALSIFIED. No arm beats V2.8: keep falls 1 below, noC only ties.
last_result.w2_mechanism: +3 re-slotted correctly (D2,D3 use A which is right; N3 uses B which is right), -2 lost (A1,A2 use A which is wrong). Net +1.
last_result.falsifiable_form: 'Balance' explains any outcome and cannot fail (Zhou was right). Write instead: removing option C moves exactly these four cells, D2/D3/N3 up, A1/A2 down, net +1. That can fail.
last_result.own_hypothesis_falsified: I claimed 'a state name is a position'. Deleting the name did not remove the position: 'go read' and 'go ask' already occupy a slot each. What occupies space is the format's slots, not the name.
last_result.design_flaw: Arms differ only in the W2 prompt; W1/W3 prompts identical; temperature=0 so 15 of 16 W1/W3 cells are byte-identical. 32 of 48 answers are repeats. Effective independent samples ~18.
last_result.clause37_proposed: Compare every cell's input text before running. Identical input cells are repeats, not contrasts.
last_result.grading_self_error: FIVE errors, all mechanical: shared-dict overwrite; reused table; identical W1 answers scored differently; W2 counted 4 vs 3; N3-W2 scored 0 although B is correct. The fifth was caught only after scripting the grading and being forced to write a REASON per cell - the reason said B is correct while the score said 0.
last_result.engineering_conclusion: The value is not that the script computes better than me. It is that writing a reason per cell leaves no room for 'done'. Four repairs did not fix it; writing reasons did.
